parameter_refs.name: highway_parking_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-reviewed public highway and permitted parking bay

parameter_refs.name: approach_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: rear or opposing source-reviewed approach route

parameter_refs.name: departure_policy
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: wait until pass, start before pass, clear approach or nonconflicting route

quote: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

activation.condition: A person controls an ordinary motor vehicle initially parked within a source-qualified highway.

exceptions.description: Outside selected permitted-parking branch; applicable no-parking context requires independent source review.
exceptions.source_clause: except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted

judgment_calls_needed.note: Selected branch is initially parked; verify highway boundaries, public dedication and original vehicle activity.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stopped, standing or parked on a highway

judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain location-specific parking rule and original date/time; selected cases require permitted parking.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted

judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure original trajectories, approach, gap and departure timing; safety has no invented numeric cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless and until such movement can be made with safety

obligation.description: Do not start the parked vehicle into movement unless and until the movement can be made with safety.

timing.description: Original parked state, approaching vehicle and attempted departure are measured across one 45-second episode.
